authored_by: Claude (triage trial session), before the sweep ran
purpose: Trial of a bounded equivalence check before a saved recipe is reused (triage row 4). Each promoted recipe is replayed against the second model query that promoted it, for every parameter value the data holds and with NULLs injected; disagreements are hand-checked.
scoring: Per flagged recipe, a hand check by reading both queries: real defect in the saved recipe / the second query is wrong / both defensible readings. Simple alternative: the current gate (one parameter value, full data and patient subsets), which passed all of these. LLM alone: the frontier model asked whether the saved query is right for its template for every parameter value.
